# Sri Ganapathy Banana Commission Mundy

> Sri Ganapathy Banana Commission Mundy is a banana procurement, commission trading, wholesale and institutional supply business in New Siddhapudur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India.

## Official website

- Homepage: https://sriganapathy-lilac.vercel.app/
- Address: 51–52, 8th Street Extension, Subbana Gounder Layout, New Siddhapudur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu 641012, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 98424 66544
- Business partners: Ragu and Muruganandham

## Services

- Banana wholesale and retail buyer enquiries in Coimbatore
- Banana procurement conversations with farmers
- Early morning commission market auctions
- Banana storage and ripening discussions
- Institutional banana supply for shops, schools, colleges, hospitals and hostels

## Accuracy note

Availability, ripening stage, quantities, terms and suitability vary with current stock and the specific enquiry. Contact the business directly for current information. This website does not publish guaranteed prices, delivery commitments, ratings or certifications.
